brief: Long three-storey Italianate commercial block of 1859 facing the courthouse square, once a hotel: painted brick with tall hooded windows and a bracketed cornice, its centre section refaced about 1910 in white Renaissance Revival terra cotta; shopfronts below.

facade.notes: the Lansing Block (Newark OH, 1859, refaced): a three-storey white glazed-terra-cotta front with a deep bracketed eave, 'OFFICES AT 6 N. PARK PLACE' on the ground floor, between a yellow-painted Italianate block with hooded windows and a white bracketed one; café tables on the brick sidewalk of the courthouse square

why.note: 1910s-20s refacing in glazed terra cotta: an old block made modern
